idea-plugin.name: MyBatis-Plus Reload
idea-plugin.description:
JRebel integration for MyBatis-Plus Mapper XML hot reload.

This plugin bundles the jrebel-mybatisplus runtime extension and automatically injects it into JRebel via -Drebel.plugins, so MyBatis-Plus Mapper XML changes can be hot-reloaded without restarting the application and without losing MyBatis-Plus injected SQL (e.g. selectPage).

No manual VM argument configuration is required — the bundled runtime is discovered and merged with any existing rebel.plugins entries on JRebel Run / JRebel Debug.

Validated with:

  • MyBatis-Plus 3.5.2
  • MyBatis-Plus 3.5.7
  • IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2

Based on the original jrebel-mybatisplus runtime by suchu. MIT License.

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 compatibility
